li.label: tin withdrawal (mild)
li.description: The world feels muffled without tin.

li.label: tin withdrawal (moderate)
li.description: Everything is dull and distant. I need tin.

li.label: tin withdrawal (severe)
li.description: I can barely see, barely hear. I'm suffocating in the silence.

li.label: pewter withdrawal (mild)
li.description: My body feels sluggish without pewter. Everything takes more effort.

li.label: pewter withdrawal (moderate)
li.description: I can barely lift my arms. My body is betraying me without pewter.

li.label: pewter withdrawal (severe)
li.description: Every step is agony. My bones grind and my muscles scream. I need pewter or I'll collapse.

li.label: brass withdrawal (mild)
li.description: Other people's emotions feel raw and unfiltered without brass.

li.label: brass withdrawal (moderate)
li.description: I can't Soothe anyone. Their feelings crash against me and I can't push back.

li.label: brass withdrawal (severe)
li.description: Every emotion around me is a storm I can't quiet. I'm drowning in feelings that aren't mine.

li.label: zinc withdrawal (mild)
li.description: Without zinc, everything feels flat and grey.

li.label: zinc withdrawal (moderate)
li.description: I feel nothing. No anger, no joy. Just hollow numbness where passion used to be.

li.label: zinc withdrawal (severe)
li.description: I am empty. The fire is gone. I'd Riot my own heart if I could, just to feel something again.

li.label: copper withdrawal (mild)
li.description: My thoughts feel exposed without the coppercloud. Hard to concentrate.

li.label: copper withdrawal (moderate)
li.description: I can't hold a thought straight. My mind wanders and scatters like mist.

li.label: copper withdrawal (severe)
li.description: My mind is naked and fragmented. Every thought slips away before I can grasp it.

li.label: bronze withdrawal (mild)
li.description: The Allomantic pulses have gone quiet. The silence is unsettling.

li.label: bronze withdrawal (moderate)
li.description: I used to feel every burn, every pulse. Now there's just a hollow ringing where awareness used to be.

li.label: bronze withdrawal (severe)
li.description: The world is deaf to me. I know they're burning out there, but I can't sense any of it. The void is maddening.
